old_problem: The source does not distinguish the M.2 management sideband from the PCIe/NVMe data path or map sideband responders to physical slots and installed devices. DeepSeek's global scan can touch EEPROM, sensor, power or reset/control endpoints and supplies no check for device disappearance, reset, namespace or media-health impact.
disposition_reason: Retain Pending and BLOCKED. NVMe enumeration does not prove the BMC/platform sideband, while an I2C response does not identify an M.2 slot or storage device. The owner must bind board revision, slot population, controller/mux/address/registers, expected response and storage-health recovery. Those define target, safe operation and PASS, not merely runtime values.
decision_basis: The exact XLSX row 1809, same-row DeepSeek/test-json, GPT V2, historical record, pending/blocked analyses and ED-01 through ED-30 were read. The next formal locked-queue identity was directly opened as Functionality row 1810 / Wistron-HW-00432-V002 / 5068136d5993e9db.
M2_BD I2C defaults to BMC/platform-management scope and must remain distinct from the PCIe/NVMe data path.
A sideband responder requires explicit correlation to slot, device serial/firmware and expected inventory/temperature/status response.
ED-03 forbids guessed OEM topology/registers and ED-15 forbids PASS without approved identity, thermal and storage-health criteria.
Unknown M.2 endpoints can include EEPROM, sensors and power/reset controls; generic scanning cannot be treated as no-risk on live storage.
No SSH, I2C, M.2, NVMe, storage, scan, write, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.pass_fail_basis: Current result is BLOCKED. NVMe enumeration or address visibility alone cannot PASS. Missing contract, wrong/missing/extra mapping, unapproved access, response mismatch, reset/disappearance, namespace/media/thermal/event change or evidence gap is FAIL/BLOCKED for owner verdict.
safety_gate: Do not access M2_BD until board revision, populated slot map and register-level sideband allowlist are approved.
Keep sideband and PCIe/NVMe evidence distinct; prohibit generic scans and power/reset/control/write/force operations.
Preserve active storage, namespace, SMART/media, kernel and BMC evidence without running writes or clearing logs.
Stop on device disappearance, reset, temperature, media, BMC or bus anomaly; do not retry/reset/reboot automatically.
expected_evidence: Approved M2_BD specification/revision and slot/device serial/firmware population map
Controller/mux/bus/address/register allowlist, exclusions, tool/version and authenticated session
Complete per-slot raw sideband responses mapped to the exact NVMe device
Pre/post NVMe presence, namespaces, SMART/media/temperature, kernel and BMC SEL/SDR health
test_case.recovery: No access or recovery action is authorized now. In a future approved run, stop on the first storage or management anomaly, preserve evidence and do not retry. Use independent console/BMC/storage recovery; any bus reset, controller reset, NVMe reset, reboot or power cycle requires a separate owner-approved procedure and authorization.
